title: After the Kikuka Sho: Just Can't Hack It

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Neither of them are able to claim victory. Mejiro Palmer tries to console her, but Mejiro McQueen sheds tears of frustration.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Seeing that, Mejiro Palmer questions whether or not she herself has that kind of passion for running.
